annotations.title: List the highest-scoring prospects for a metal

description: Use when the user asks where the highest-scoring ground for a metal is across Western Australia. Returns up to `n` spaced-apart cells of the precomputed prospectivity grid, sorted by score, highest first, each with its coordinates and a mapUrl. Set exclude_nogo to leave out cells inside DBCA conservation reserves.

exclude_nogo.description: Leave out cells inside DBCA conservation reserves.

name: top_prospects
